{"body":"Upgrades all pinned versions. Closes #90.

- vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 5.1.1, knip 6.46.1, @j178/prek 0.5.11, oxfmt 0.79.0, oxlint 1.94.0, and transitive updates in `package-lock.json`
- `actions/create-github-app-token` v3.4.0 (pinned by SHA) in `pi-assistant.yml`
- pit [v0.39.0](https://github.com/cv/pit/releases/tag/v0.39.0) in `pi-assistant.yml` and `docs/extensions.md`

Already at the latest: the pi packages (1.5.2), @actions/*, jiti, typescript, @types/node, commitlint, jscpd, actionlint, oxlint-tsgolint, `actions/checkout@v7`, and `actions/setup-node@v7`.

`npm run check` passes.","title":"build(deps): upgrade dependencies, app token action, and pit"}

----
{"body":"Follow-up to #91 for #90: update the docs to match the latest versions.

The example log in `docs/how-it-works.md` showed a run with an old pit: the model got `read, write, edit, bash, typescript`, and the calls were `bash` and `edit` calls. With pit v0.39.0 the model gets only `typescript`, the 🔧 line shows the label of each program, and the ↳ line shows the functions it used. The example now shows that.

The other version references in the docs are already current (pit v0.39.0, `actions/checkout@v7`, `cv/pi-action@v2`, pi 1.5.2), or are minimum versions for features (pit 0.36.x), or are the example of a pit before 0.36 (v0.35.1, the last such release).

`npm run check` passes.","title":"docs: show the workflow log of a run with pit v0.39.0"}
